claims.evidence: Photos show physical appearance only; quality cannot be assessed remotely.
No origin or location marking visible in photos; brand and model unreadable.
Witness report identifies an electronic keyboard with keys, control panel, and speaker grilles.
Audio output cannot be assessed from still photos; speaker function is not shown.

Video of every key being pressed and producing sound
Audio clip or video of sound coming from the speakers
Close-up photo or video of the screen showing information
Video of buttons and knobs being adjusted with response
Photo of serial number label or original receipt

risks.proof: Photo of the power adapter and cable with the keyboard

risks.risk: Whether stand or bench is included
risks.proof: Photo showing stand or bench with the keyboard

risks.risk: Whether it has water damage or repairs
risks.proof: Close-up photos of ports, seams, and underside for corrosion or new screws
